SELECT 
  (m."orderbook_metrics"->>'mid_price')::real as mid_price,
  (m."orderbook_metrics"->>'mark_price')::real as mark_price,
  r."margin_risk_profile"->>'liquidation_price' as liquidation_price,
  r."margin_risk_profile"->>'position_side' as position_side,
  r."MARG_FORM",
  m."EXCH_SPOT"
FROM riskandmargin r
JOIN orders o ON r."ordStamp" = o."ORD_STAMP"
JOIN marketdata m ON o."exchSpot" = m."EXCH_SPOT"
WHERE o."ORD_STAMP" = 'OR6015391';

SELECT 
  (m."orderbook_metrics"->>'mid_price')::real as mid_price,
  (m."orderbook_metrics"->>'mark_price')::real as mark_price,
  (r."margin_risk_profile"->>'liquidation_price')::real as liquidation_price,
  r."margin_risk_profile"->>'position_side' as position_side,
  CASE 
    WHEN (r."margin_risk_profile"->>'position_side')::text = 'Short' THEN
      CASE WHEN (r."margin_risk_profile"->>'liquidation_price')::real <= (m."orderbook_metrics"->>'mid_price')::real * 1.05 THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Safe' END
    ELSE
      CASE WHEN (r."margin_risk_profile"->>'liquidation_price')::real >= (m."orderbook_metrics"->>'mid_price')::real * 0.95 THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Safe' END
  END as risk_level
FROM riskandmargin r
JOIN orders o ON r."ordStamp" = o."ORD_STAMP"
JOIN marketdata m ON o."exchSpot" = m."EXCH_SPOT"
WHERE o."ORD_STAMP" = 'OR6015391';
